notes:
Lead type: inbound SMB (self-serve sign-up).

Background: Mid-stage SaaS company building a customer support automation layer. Came in via referrals + quickstart templates. Small infra team; prefers managed services. Currently using a mix of rule-based search + third-party embedding provider.

Procurement / Billing:
- Primary ask on call: is credit-card checkout OK for pilot? Team wants CC for < $5k; will consider invoice/PO if commitment > $10k.
- Startup discount asked: "Can Redwood extend a startup promo?" — Emma asked for a trial extension after credits depleted.
- Request: 30-day free credits extension + 10% pilot discount.
- Quote: interested in seeing monthly pricing examples for 100k monthly tokens + 50k embeddings.
- Note: Legal only requires invoice + PO if >25k ARR; otherwise CC OK. (sales said keep invoice template ready.)

Technical / Use-case details:
- Primary workloads: support-agent (chat), doc-search (vector embeddings), light reranking for KB retrieval.
- Latency SLO: 150-300ms for chat median; p95 < 700ms acceptable.
- Throughput: expecting bursty traffic, avg 40 req/s, peak ~120 req/s during business hours.
- Cost sensitivity: high — cost per token and per-embedding units matter. Open to quantized/cheaper model variants for non-critical paths.
- Model preference: leaning toward open models (Llama-family / redwood-verified variants). Wants fallback to smaller models for non-interactive tasks.

Security / Compliance:
- Small security team — want SSO (Google Workspace SAML) + basic audit logging. SOC2 planned but not required for pilot.
- Data residency: US preferred; no hard residency constraint for pilot.

POC / Success criteria:
- 2-week pilot: integrate hosted API into support stack (Zendesk + in-house chat), run 5k conversations, measure latency/cost, and evaluate answer quality on 200 labeled prompts.
- Success: 10% reduction in first-reply SLA + acceptable quality (>80% on eval prompts) and cost < threshold agreed during pricing review.

Ops / Routing asks:
- Prefer NA region; want automatic fallback to lower-cost model when token budget threshold crossed. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions.

Internal quotes / paraphrases:
- "We want something that just works — don't want to manage infrastructure." — Head of Product.
notes_short: Inbound SMB lead; self-serve trial exhausted. Wants CC for small pilot, invoice only for larger commits. Requests startup discount + 30d credit extension. POC 2 weeks, NA hosted API, SSO + audit logs. SE deep-dive scheduled.
